measures.title: Santa Ana Streets, Public Safety, Essential City Services Measure
measures.summary: Amends Santa Ana's existing local sales (transactions and use) tax, approved by voters in 2018, which is scheduled to drop from 1.5 cents to 1 cent on April 1, 2029 and to end on April 1, 2039. The measure removes both the rate reduction and the end date, keeping the tax at 1.5 cents until ended by voters, providing about $84 million a year for general city services. Existing requirements for a citizen oversight committee, annual independent audits and annual disclosure of spending remain in place.
measures.yesMeans: Santa Ana's 1.5-cent local sales tax would continue at its current rate with no scheduled reduction or end date, until ended by voters.
measures.noMeans: The tax would drop to 1 cent on April 1, 2029 and end on April 1, 2039, as currently scheduled.
